newsitem.title: USA: China buys at least 20,000 T U.S. soyoil - exporters.
newsitem.headline: China buys at least 20,000 T U.S. soyoil - exporters.

text.p: China recently purchased at least 20,000 tonnes of U.S. soyoil for shipment from the Gulf of Mexico in the next seven days, U.S. export sources said.
"It's absolutely correct," said one exporter. "The business has been done."
A export source with another company said one company holds the option to ship an additional 10,000 tonnes, also within the next week. That would bring the total shipment to 30,000 tonnes, he said.
Chicago Board of Trade soyoil futures closed sharply higher Wednesday. December soyoil settled up 0.21 cent per lb at 23.37 cents, and January closed up 0.19 cent at 23.65.
Cash market sources said talk of soy product sales to China were partly responsible for the CBOT futures gains.
